coordinator_note: Every theoretical value read against its quotes. Habibi: Theorems 5.2 and 5.3 omit the condition 0 <= gamma < 1 from their statements; only the proof of 5.2 uses it, and Section 6 allows gamma = 1, where the contraction fails, so both theorems and the existence claim are LOW. Hadjidimoulas: Theorem 4.2, the identity-pair results, Theorems 4.9 and 4.16 and Proposition A.2 are quoted with their conditions and stay HIGH; Theorems 4.7 and 4.12 are LOW because their conclusions are not quoted. Harviainen: Theorems 7 and 10 are quoted with their conditions (Theorem 10 only under SETH, for classical algorithms) and stay HIGH; Theorem 3's square-root bound is not quoted. Heidari: Theorems 3 and 4 print 3^k while the proof of Theorem 3, the sentence after Theorem 4 and Appendix D use 9^k, and the locality condition is printed as both Omega(log p) and O(log p); every Heidari theoretical item is LOW. Heightman: most propositions are quoted only up to their formulas; Proposition 5's proof argues one direction; Proposition 7 does not follow from its definition by the reader's check; the N(N-1) sphere count in Proposition 18 is not derived; all LOW
